name: orca-monorepo
description: ORCA — Marine EcoSystem Reasoning with Collaborative Agents (ISRO SIH26176)

scripts.dev: start "ORCA Frontend" cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev" && start "ORCA Backend" cmd /k "cd backend && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
